content.text:
For intermittent fasting, filtered to Randomized Controlled Trial, PubMed showed 33 results for 2023 and 6 for 2015. 2023 exceeds 2015 by 27 (33 − 6).

I got the counts by loading the filtered search pages in the browser. The 2023 page showed "33 results". The 2015 page showed "6 results" under "Filters applied: Randomized Controlled Trial, from 2015 - 2015". The results-by-year table on that page also lists 33 for 2023 and 6 for 2015.

ANSWER: 33; 6; 27
